title: Lab: build a custom AI assistant with a full system prompt
body:
🛠 Lab exercise

Design a complete system prompt for an AI assistant of your choosing (a study buddy, a recipe helper, a travel planning assistant — anything). Your system prompt should include all four elements:

  1. A clear persona (name, personality, expertise).
  2. Scope — what it helps with, and what it should decline or redirect.
  3. At least 3 specific rules or guardrails.
  4. A default response format/length.

If you have access to a tool that lets you set a custom system prompt (many AI chat apps offer this under "custom instructions"), try it out and test whether the assistant follows your rules across a few different requests.
